title: NASA-JAXA XRISM mission sees a pulsar gathering a companion star's wind
summary: XRISM observations gave astronomers a detailed look at a giant star's wind being captured by a compact companion, helping researchers study the process powering strong X-ray flares.

title: NASA Hubble spots an out-of-sync galaxy
summary: A new Hubble observation reveals a spiral galaxy whose apparently calm appearance hides a more chaotic environment.

title: NASA's Moon orbiter spots a new once-in-a-century crater
summary: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter data revealed a newly formed crater on the Moon, offering researchers a rare chance to study a recent impact and its effects on the surrounding surface.

title: CERN begins disconnecting the LHC for the HiLumi upgrade
summary: CERN has begun disconnecting focusing magnets around ATLAS and CMS as part of the Long Shutdown 3 work leading to the High-Luminosity LHC.

title: CERN starts installing upgraded CMS muon electronics
summary: Teams have started installing new electronics for the CMS Drift Tube chambers, preparing the detector for the higher collision rates expected in the HiLumi LHC era.

title: NASA restores its Guam Remote Station after Typhoon Mawar
summary: NASA marked the full restoration of its Guam Remote Station, closing out a major recovery effort after damage from Typhoon Mawar.
